title: Players roll their own dice: a PC attack prompts the player, never rolls for them

llm_context.canon: Table rule: players roll their own dice. When Aria attacks, prompt her to roll — never roll her attack or damage for her. The GM rolls only for NPCs and monsters.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I attack the goblin with my longsword!

actions.text: You close the distance in two strides, blade coming down in a hard arc toward the goblin's guard.

actions.question: Roll your longsword attack against the goblin (d20 + your attack bonus).
